summary.text: Anthony Ramirez is the No Labels Party candidate for Arizona State Senate District 12 in the November 3, 2026 general election, alongside Democrat Patricia Contreras and Republican write-in candidate Gary Hatch.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as an Arizona attorney, private investigator, former police officer and small business owner.

paragraphs.text: Anthony Ramirez earned a high school diploma from J. M. Hanks High School, a bachelor's degree from Ottawa University in 2003 and a law degree from Arizona Summit Law School in 2015.
His career experience includes working as an attorney.
Ramirez advanced from the No Labels Party primary for District 12 on July 21, 2026.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he is running as a true independent and will not caucus with either party.
